MADONNA'S BEDTIME PAJAMA PARTY 2.0 · new recut special edition

To mark the 30th anniversary of the Bedtime Stories album, here’s a special video edit of Madonna’s iconic 'Pajama Party', held at Webster Hall (NY) in 1995. This re-edited cut, assembled from the promo tape of the original broadcast and rare deleted B-roll raw footage, offers an extended version of the event, featuring Madonna’s complete arrival, full dancing sequences, and more unseen on-stage moments, all seamlessly synced to the HQ/studio version of the remixes DJ’d live that night by Junior Vasquez. Also included are M's backstage interview with MTV legend Kurt Loder, and her lively, uncut reading of Miss Spider’s Tea Party. A treat for Madonna stans - for there is nothing better than watching this woman dance her tits out on excellent 90s house music. So crank it up and enjoy the party !
